notes:
Lyriix Android 0.2.1 beta

- Relay mobile playback to Discord through your paired PC on the same Wi-Fi. Discord shows the song, artist, public artwork and “Listening on mobile.” Keep Lyriix and Discord open on the PC and enable the PC's Discord presence setting. Requires Windows 0.11.21 or newer.
- Mobile presence keeps working with the screen off, clears when paused and expires after a disconnected phone stops reporting. Disable sharing in Android Settings whenever you want.
- Add audio from your phone's Downloads using “Add music from phone.” Original files stay untouched; saved copies play offline and stay available when your PC is disconnected. Identical file content is reused instead of saving another copy.
- Resume waiting downloads without losing partial files. A linear retry delay replaces exponential backoff, waiting reasons stay visible, and reconnecting Wi-Fi wakes stalled retries. Repeated download taps keep the same unique queue item.
- Check the update signing identity before downloading. A matching-key update keeps the existing music, lyrics, likes, playlists and pairing. An incompatible preview update is blocked with instructions to keep the current app installed.

Do not uninstall or clear app storage to force an incompatible update. Early private debug previews need a separate backup/migration if their original signing key is unavailable.
